title: Ben Yatzaf

paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Taanit, chapter 4, halakhah 2, Rabbi Levi said that a genealogy scroll was found in Jerusalem containing: “Ben Yatzaf, descended from Asaf.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The consulted scroll lists Hillel from David, Ben Yatzaf from Asaf and other family lines; the local English renders the genealogical context without binding authority records.

The whole consulted Guggenheimer paragraph in Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:2 has Rabbi Levi report a genealogy scroll containing Ben Yatzaf from Asaf. The existing note’s references to other families are retained as historical editorial context; no additional family biography is supplied here, and the scroll’s reported lineage is not an independently established identification.
